description.narrative:
Project: Amplifying Marginalized Youth Voices
This project empowers marginalized minority youth in Somaliland (“Daami”), includingyoung women and men aged 18–35, to actively participate in civic life, decision-making, and community development. Through youth-led committees, participatory planning, peer mentorship, and skills-building activities, the project strengthens leadership, amplifiesyouth voices, and promotes inclusion, equity, and social accountability. By engaging youth in all stages of design, implementation,and evaluation, the project ensures that interventions reflect their priorities and address barriers such as social exclusion, limited education, employment, and civic opportunities. The initiative fosters sustainable, youth-driven impact and strengthens marginalized youth agency, representation, and leadership across Somaliland.
Project Goal, Objectives, and Activities
Goal: Empower marginalized minority youth (“Daami”) in Somaliland to lead change in their communities.
Objectives: 1) Strengthen youth leadership and civic engagement; 2) Amplify youth voices in decision-making; 3) Promote inclusive, youth-driven community initiatives.
Activities: Establish youth-led committees, conduct participatory planning and peer mentorship, implement community projects, and monitor and evaluate outcomes, ensuring young people drive all stages of project design and implementation..

participating-org.narrative:
Daami Youth Development Organization (DYDO) is a Somaliland-based, marginalized minority–led and youth-driven civil society organization advancing social justice, inclusion, human rights, and sustainable development. Founded and led by young people from historically marginalized minority communities, DYDO works to ensure underserved youth meaningfully participate in governance, civic life, and development processes that affect their futures.
Vision: A just, inclusive, and resilient Somaliland where marginalized youth andminority communities enjoy equal rights, opportunities, and representation.
Mission: To empower marginalized and minority youth through civic engagement, peacebuilding, climate action, digital inclusion, and sustainable livelihoods.
Key Objectives: Amplifying youth voices in governance and policy dialogue; promoting human rights, minority inclusion, and peaceful social cohesion; strengthening community resilience through climate-responsive initiatives; and enhancing digital literacy, digital security, and safe civic space.
Experience: DYDO has implemented youth- and minority-focused programs across Somaliland in partnership with MRG, NIMD, DRC, Save the Children, HIVOS, DDP, UNICEF, DANIDA, and UN human rights mechanisms, using participatory, community-led, and accountable approaches.
Values: Inclusion, equity, youth leadership, participation, transparency, accountability, and respect for diversity.
